items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: one of the first people I saw when I got to the festival was Nan

ctx.x: And he came and he didn't want me to do any of the songs that I had done for Black and Blue. I said, 'well I won't do that.' And so one of the first people I saw when I got to the festival was Nan and he had his attorney with him. He said, 'I brought my attorney'. I said, 'well you didn't need no attorney.' I said, 'I told you I wasn't going to do it. So that was all that mattered.' So he said, 'well we're going to see.' I said, 'well, you don't have to see'.
